2124829510092898349.en_summary: BREAKING: CrowdStrike $CRWD is buying Zscaler $ZS in a roughly $44 billion all-stock deal, the largest cybersecurity acquisition ever. Zscaler shareholders will receive 1.135 CrowdStrike shares for each Zscaler share, about $260.41 apiece. That’s a roughly 34% premium to Zscaler’s Nov. 20 close. CrowdStrike holders will own about 84% of the combined company, and Zscaler holders about 16%. Zscaler founder and CEO Jay Chaudhry will keep running the Zscaler business and join CrowdStrike’s board. He and his affiliates, who own about 34% of Zscaler, have agreed to vote for the deal.
2124829510092898349.zh_summary: 突發：CrowdStrike $CRWD 以約 440 億美元的全股票交易收購 Zscaler $ZS，這是有史以來最大的網絡安全收購。Zscaler 股東每持有一股 Zscaler 股票將獲得 1.135 股 CrowdStrike 股票，約每股 260.41 美元。這比 Zscaler 11 月 20 日收盤價高出約 34% 的溢價。CrowdStrike 持有人將擁有合併公司約 84%，Zscaler 持有人約 16%。Zscaler 創始人兼首席執行官 Jay Chaudhry 將繼續運營 Zscaler 業務並加入 CrowdStrike 董事會。他及其關聯方持有約 34% 的 Zscaler，已同意投票支持該交易。
